from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta
import hashlib, json, gzip, re, subprocess
root = Path.cwd()
out = root / "reports/research/510300_original_real_industrial_sales_and_base_joint_cause_source_review_v1"
out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
def now():
    return datetime.now(timezone(timedelta(hours=8))).isoformat()
def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def read(path):
    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
def save(name, value):
    path = out / name
    if path.exists():
        raise RuntimeError("来源登记已有，禁止覆盖：" + str(path))
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    return {"path": str(path.relative_to(root)).replace("\\", "/"), "sha256": sha(path)}

proposal = read(proposal_path)
if proposal["experiment_id"] != "E113" or proposal["status"] != "PROPOSED_NOT_REGISTERED_NOT_RUN":
    raise RuntimeError("非原E113未执行提案")
for parent in proposal["parents"]:
    if sha(root / parent["path"]) != parent["sha256"]:
        raise RuntimeError("原提案父证据变化")
cfg = read(root / "config/510300_historical_cause_discovery_v1.json")
if cfg["latest_goal_turn_audit"]["current_turn_experiment_ids"] != ["E112"]:
    raise RuntimeError("上轮权威导航变化，需要重新读取")
cache_root = root / "data/nbs_monthly/runs/20261004_national_full"
index_path = cache_root / "releases_status.json"
index = read(index_path)
selection = []
new_queries = []
cache_files = []
for fixed in proposal["fixed_original_periods"]:
    year, month = [int(part) for part in fixed["economic_period"].split("M")]
    title_period = str(year) + "年" + ("1—2" if month == 2 else str(month)) + "月份"
    prefix = title_period.replace("—", "-") + "规模以上工业增加值"
    matched = [entry for entry in index["releases"] if re.sub(r"\s+", "", entry["title"]).replace("—", "-").startswith(prefix)]
    row = dict(fixed)
    row["fixed_query_if_missing"] = 'site:stats.gov.cn "' + title_period + '" "规模以上工业增加值" "产销率"'
    if matched:
        chosen = matched[0]
        raw_path = cache_root / chosen["raw_path"]
        raw_bytes = gzip.decompress(raw_path.read_bytes())
        if hashlib.sha256(raw_bytes).hexdigest() != chosen["sha256"]:
            raise RuntimeError("已存同原响应与发布索引哈希不符：" + fixed["economic_period"])
        row.update({"acquisition": "REUSE_EXISTING_SAME_ORIGINAL_FULL_RESPONSE", "cache_original_entry": chosen, "source_url": chosen["url"], "cache_raw_path": str(raw_path.relative_to(root)).replace("\\", "/"), "cache_gzip_sha256": sha(raw_path), "raw_html_sha256": chosen["sha256"], "raw_bytes": len(raw_bytes)})
        cache_files.append({"path": row["cache_raw_path"], "sha256": row["cache_gzip_sha256"]})
    else:
        row["acquisition"] = "ONE_FIXED_LOCATOR_PENDING"
        new_queries.append({"economic_period": fixed["economic_period"], "q": row["fixed_query_if_missing"], "domains": ["stats.gov.cn"]})
    selection.append(row)
assert len(selection) == 13 and len(new_queries) == 8 and len(cache_files) == 5
selection_file = save("原13期本地同原载体复用与八缺原定位集合_E113.json", {"at": now(), "cache_index_path": str(index_path.relative_to(root)).replace("\\", "/"), "cache_index_sha256_at_selection": sha(index_path), "selected_rows": selection, "existing_source_reused": 5, "missing_fixed_queries": new_queries, "cache_current_receipt_not_historical_first_vintage": True, "cache_source_not_modified": True})
old_paths = [

"reports/research/510300_macro_surprise_event_binary_screen_v1.json",
"reports/research/510300_real_activity_followthrough_v17/protocol.json",
"reports/research/510300_real_activity_followthrough_v17/第十七轮_经营传导兑现与剩余收益.md",
"scripts/analyze_nbs_monthly.py", "scripts/analyze_nbs_multiyear.py",
"data/nbs_monthly/runs/20261004_national_full/scope.json"
]
old_result = read(root / old_paths[1])

    "legacy_industrial_production_use": {"study_id": old_result["study_id"], "status": old_result["status"], "decision": old_result["decision"], "candidate_count": 8, "passing_candidates": old_result["passing_candidates"], "same_financial_use_reopened": False},

    "old_saved_performance_reports_read_for_prior_use": True, "current_fixed13_stock_labels_read": False,
    "current_database_vintage": "2026-10-04取得的全国月度数据库，当前修订历史不能替代原13期公开时钟/首版",

    "local_raw_full_response_reuse": 5, "missing_original_carriers": 8,
    "financial_candidates_admitted": 0, "old_failures_preserved": True,
    "search_is_bounded_not_whole_repo_exhaustive": True,
    "legacy_sources": [{"path": path, "sha256": sha(root / path)} for path in old_paths]
})

    "experiment_id": "E113", "study_id": proposal["study_id"], "registered_at": now(),
    "status": "REGISTERED_13_ORIGINAL_PERIODS_5_LOCAL_REUSES_8_FIXED_QUERIES_BEFORE_NEW_REQUESTS",
    "question": proposal["question"], "unit_of_analysis": proposal["unit_of_analysis"],
    "fixed_original_periods": proposal["fixed_original_periods"],
    "fixed_acquisition_selection": selection_file, "queries_fixed_before_new_requests": new_queries,
    "source_role": "全国单项工业增加值原数量发布及其中产销率/出口交货值/两年平均/方法；与原利润、PPI和PMI意见分开",
    "reuse_rule": "复用已存五同原gzip响应，解压原HTML哈希必须与已存发布索引一致；保留旧取得时刻/可能重试来源，不追认为本轮新首GET。已存对应原期不追加查询。",
    "new_source_selection_rule": "每缺原期一次固定定位，按返回顺序选首个原NBS全国单项工业增加值全文，原年原月或1—2合并必须一致；排除地方/目录/国民经济综合/利润/PMI/其他原期；无匹配UNKNOWN，不补定位或换载体。",
    "complete_source_rule": "保存原完整正文、全原表和附注/季调修订/统计母体/可比口径；TRS_Editor/TRS_UEDITOR/TRS_PreAppend同文副本不作独立来源。",
    "clock_rule": "使用同原页明确PubDate或正文头日期时刻，日期只有日则当日末；不得晚于对应原共同截止。URL/成文/取得/缓存目录不补原公布钟；历史首版仍未认证。",
    "quantity_contract": {
        "value_added": "官方扣除价格因素的实际增长速度，是生产增加值而非利润/EPS；保留当月、累计、1—2合并。",
        "two_year_average": "仅原文明确公布的相对2019两年平均/比2019累计，不能当市场共识或精确预期差，不自行从修订数据库重构。",
        "sales_ratio": "原工业产品销售率及同比百分点，销售产值/工业总产值的价值比率，不是现金回收率或净利润率。",
        "export_delivery": "原人民币交货金额及名义同比，不是海关美元出口、实物订单、实际收到现金或纯量增长。",

        "population": "原规上工业企业统计总体/可比调整，不是沪深300当前成员/行业权重，不机械将名义收入减实际增加值当纯价格贡献。"
    },
    "joint_attribution_rule": "全13期保留原完整同钟价格、资金价量、订单、收入利润、应收/回收、库存/周转及有年龄基金；每例最多1主要机制和2竞争解释，原直接量、原归因和推测/UNKNOWN分开。后一经营量只作历史结果。",
    "limits": {"local_original_source_reuses": 5, "new_fixed_locator_queries": 8, "maximum_distinct_new_first_raw_GETs": 8, "one_first_GET_per_missing_period": True, "GET_concurrency_max": 3, "connect_timeout_seconds": 12, "read_timeout_seconds": 30, "TLS_verify": True, "new_GET_retries": 0, "alternate_carrier_GETs": 0, "extra_queries": 0, "authenticated_requests": 0},
    "financial_budget": {"new_financial_candidates": 0, "new_model_fits": 0, "new_linear_regressions": 0, "new_simple_weighted_scores": 0, "new_stock_labels_generated": 0, "current_fixed13_stock_labels_read": False, "new_full_accounts": 0, "existing_source_code_edits": 0},
    "parents": proposal["parents"] + [{"path": str(proposal_path.relative_to(root)).replace("\\", "/"), "sha256": sha(proposal_path)}, selection_file, prior_file, *cache_files],
    "old_E110_E112_conditions_outcomes_grids_baselines_denominators_unchanged": True,
    "original79_1711_1212_preserved": True,
    "closed_E109_E108_price_E111_cause_routes_preserved": True,
    "old_macro_surprise_PMI_production_order_electricity_models_not_reopened": True,
    "historical_first_vintage_authenticated": False, "independent_validation": False,
    "case_selection_is_post_result_historical_explanation": True,
    "financial_admission_pass": False, "net_sharpe": "NOT_COMPUTED", "goal_achieved": False,
    "current_view": "NO_VIEW", "position": "UNSET", "orders_authorized": False, "prospective_forecasts": False
}
saved = save("protocol.json", protocol)
for row in selection:
    if row["acquisition"] == "REUSE_EXISTING_SAME_ORIGINAL_FULL_RESPONSE":
        raw_bytes = gzip.decompress((root / row["cache_raw_path"]).read_bytes())
        target = out / (row["economic_period"] + "_已存同原完整响应复用_E113.html")
        if target.exists():
            raise RuntimeError("复用响应已有")
        target.write_bytes(raw_bytes)
        save(row["economic_period"] + "_已存原稿复用回执_E113.json", {"economic_period": row["economic_period"], "source_url": row["source_url"], "cache_original_entry": row["cache_original_entry"], "raw_path": str(target.relative_to(root)).replace("\\", "/"), "raw_sha256": sha(target), "copied_at": now(), "new_network_requests": 0, "inherited_original_acquisition_not_counted_as_this_turn_first_GET": True, "historical_first_vintage_authenticated": False})
def git(*args):
    return subprocess.run(["git", *args], capture_output=True, text=True, encoding="utf-8", check=True).stdout
save("运行前git记录_E113.json", {"at": now(), "branch": git("branch", "--show-current").strip(), "HEAD": git("rev-parse", "HEAD").strip(), "tracked_status": git("status", "--short", "--untracked-files=no"), "existing_source_code_edits": 0})
